notes.title: The game will be released!
notes.content:
B-RAIN will be released on March 1st!
On YouTube and other places, it says February 23rd... It has been confirmed as March 1st.

It's free to play, so please download it when you're bored.

This game was created through a hackathon competition at a school in-school competition with team members.
Various bugs that affect the game will continue to be monitored and fixed, but it will be difficult to promise continuous updates.
I want to invest time in this game in my next work, and I'm still a student, so there's a lot to do besides development.

Still, I will update it when I have time to invest in this game. Thank you!
